text: As Mayor of Inglewood, I'm committed to bringing every neighborhood up to the same standard as our thriving entertainment district because every resident and business deserves safe streets, opportunity, and a high quality of life.

I'm a mother, business owner, community organizer, and lawyer who has spent over a decade advocating for our community. My experience, education, and training prepares me to lead with compassion, integrity, fiscal responsibility, and results.

As Mayor, I'll eliminate deficits, create revenue streams, revitalize Market Street, support small businesses, create youth programs, expand senior services, improve our parks, solve traffic challenges, create services for the unhoused, implement stronger rent control, and make City Hall transparent, accessible, and responsive.

Public safety means protecting our community through trust, accountability, and professionalism in our police department. I'll implement policies that protect the rights and dignity of all residents and ensure our city isn't a place where people are targeted, intimidated, or harmed by ICE or our police.

I'm not seeking this office for a title. I'm seeking it to serve the people. I'll bring transparency, competence, accountability, compassion, and solutions to City Hall. It's time for Inglewood's next chapter, and I'm the best person to usher it in.

text: Mayor James T. Butts respectfully asks for your vote for reelection as Mayor of Inglewood. Under my leadership, Inglewood has undergone a historic transformation, emerging as a city of opportunity, growth, and renewed pride. Mayor Butts has worked to strengthen public safety, provide services for youth and seniors, revitalize neighborhoods, and attract major economic development that has brought jobs, investment, and international recognition to our community.

During my tenure, Inglewood has seen new housing, rent control, improved city services, upgraded infrastructure, and the arrival of world-class sports and entertainment venues that have expanded the city's tax base without raising taxes on residents. Mayor Butts has focused on fiscal responsibility, balanced budgets, and long-term planning to ensure Inglewood's progress benefits both current residents and future generations.

A long-term public servant with decades of leadership experience, Mayor Butts remains committed to safe streets, economic opportunity, and a high quality of life for every family in Inglewood. I believe Inglewood's best days are still ahead. I am dedicated to building on the momentum that has made Inglewood a model for urban progress.
Vote James T. Butts for Mayor of Inglewood — experienced leadership, proven results, and a stronger future for all.

text: I am a lifelong Inglewood resident of 47 years, a homeowner, an Inglewood High School graduate (98), and a graduate of CSULB with a Bachelor of Science degree. A devoted husband and father of two, 11&5. I have worked in technology and business, managing complex budgets, teams, and systems for over 25 years. Inglewood is my home. I have watched our city grow under the bright lights of a new entertainment district. I believe that growth must lift the longtime families who built this community rather than push them out. As mayor I will fight for affordable housing, tax relief, and generational wealth workshops so our elders and children can stay rooted here. I will demand fiscal fairness so big venues contribute their fair share instead of shifting the burden onto residents. I will restore real public safety with more patrols and full police body-camera accountability so every resident can trust the officers who protect us.
I am not a career politician. I am one of you, a neighbor, a father, a homeowner, and a fighter.
Together we will keep our roots deep and our future bright.

text: Age: 82
Occupation: Inglewood City Councilwoman

For generations, Inglewood has been a city built by hardworking families, resilience, and opportunity. As your City Councilwoman and after more than 30 years serving Los Angeles County in healthcare administration, I have dedicated my life to public service, accountable leadership, and delivering results.

Together, we have helped position Inglewood as one of Southern California's most dynamic cities. Now, it's time to ensure every resident and every neighborhood shares in that success as we build the next chapter of our city's future.

As your Mayor, I will focus on the priorities that matter most: safe neighborhoods, responsive city services, affordable housing, support for renters and homeowners, good-paying union jobs, thriving small businesses, quality healthcare through strong community partnerships, and a transparent, accountable City Hall that puts residents first.

I believe progress should be measured not only by new development, but by the quality of life we create. Every investment should strengthen our neighborhoods, every voice should be heard, and every family should have the opportunity to succeed.
My vision is One Inglewood—a city united by purpose, where opportunity reaches every neighborhood, families thrive, businesses grow, and future generations are proud to call Inglewood home.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Age: 47
Occupation: Inglewood Community Leader

I believe in the promise of Inglewood. That's why I refuse to stand idle. Born and raised in Inglewood, I graduated from Morningside High School in 1997 and earned my bachelor's at Cal State Dominguez. At 20 years old, I began my career serving our community with Stop the Violence Increase the Peace Foundation in the city of Inglewood. Today, I continue my commitment to empowering our community through prevention and intervention programs for at-risk youth and by leading educational awareness programs for youth and the community. There is so much we could accomplish for our city if we had the right leadership with the right priorities. My commitment to you when elected includes the following: transparency and accountability, support for small businesses, housing security and affordability and improved public safety and social services. As a community leader, wife, and mother, I am running for Mayor to put the people first and expand opportunity for all. We deserve a mayor that prioritize the needs of our community, not outside interests or mega corporations. I humbly ask for your vote to ensure our community has a voice at city hall.

text: I'm running for mayor to build an Inglewood where every resident has a real stake in our future. This city is my home. As a third-generation resident, I was raised by a family that taught me the value of faith, hard work, and community accountability. Today, I am raising my five-year-old daughter, Canela, on those very same streets. I want her to inherit a community that is stronger, fairer, and full of opportunity.

As a small business owner who has weathered both economic prosperity and struggle, I understand what our entrepreneurs face daily. My platform focuses on three main pillars: empowering our youth with real leadership opportunities, supporting neighborhood businesses so they can thrive, and enacting term limits to ensure accountable, responsive leadership. My ultimate duty is to the people who raised me, stand beside me, and share this city with me.

Our community deserves fresh energy and practical solutions. Together, we can open doors for every family and preserve what makes us special. I respectfully ask for your vote to protect the Soul of Inglewood.
